name: Jikan Teishi Gakuen! Kimo Debu no Ore ga Jikan o Tomete Gakuen no Onna-tachi o Yaritai Houdai!
original_name: 時間停止学園！キモデブのオレが時間を止めて学園の女達をヤリたい放題！
source:
"Oi, get out of the way. What are you looking at?
Omigod this janitor is staring at me!"

The students treated me like crap, but I wasn't angry. I just smiled and moved along.
It was true, I was kind of pathetic, but grateful for the job. You'll get no trouble from me.
That being said, who in the F*UCK were these schoolgirls?
What ever happened to manners?
Maybe it's the sign of our times.
I'm a janitor, but people themselves have become trash. Japan is doomed, I thought.
Then, he came to me...

"You want the power to change society?... Here you go."

It was the ghost of Sazaemon, the man who founded this school.
He gave me the ability to stop time, for the specific purpose of fixing this lousy generation.

I burnish the fourth dimensional gavel of discipline!
When the clock stops, my cock plunges!

translation:
“喂，滚开。你在看什么？
天啊，这个清洁工一直盯着我！”

学生们把我当垃圾一样对待，但我并不生气。我只是微笑着走开。
确实，我有点窝囊，但我很感激这份工作。你们不用担心我惹麻烦。
话说回来，这些女学生到底是谁？
礼貌都去哪儿了？
也许这就是时代的征兆。
我是清洁工，但人类本身已经变成了垃圾。我心想，日本没救了。
就在那时，他出现在我面前……

“你想要改变社会的力量吗？……拿去吧。”

他是佐左卫门的幽灵，也就是这所学校的创始人。
为了修正这个糟糕的时代，他赋予了我停止时间的能力。

我将磨亮第四维度的纪律之锤！
时钟停止之时，我的巨物便会刺入！
